apiDocs.title: MakeKeeper API
apiDocs.description:
REST API for the MakeKeeper backend. Endpoints are grouped by the plugin that owns them.

**Authentication.** Secured routes use a Bearer JWT, active only when the multiuser plugin is enabled (single-user mode needs no auth).

The simplest way to authorize: click **Authorize**, and in the **oauth2 (password)** section enter your username and password — the docs fetch a token and attach it to every request automatically (leave client credentials blank). No account yet? `POST /api/auth/register` first.

Prefer a token by hand? Call `POST /api/auth/login` with `{ "username", "password" }`, take the response `token`, and either paste it into the **bearer** section of the Authorize dialog or send it as the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

diskUsage.summary: Disk usage of stored attachments, broken down by owner, scope and rendition
diskUsage.purgeSummary: Delete stored files that no attachment record claims (older than the safety grace period)
diskUsage.browseSummary: List one level of the uploads directory, with each subdirectory rolled up to what it contains
diskUsage.deleteSummary: Delete an explicit selection of stored files or directories; claimed and plugin-reserved paths are refused
diskUsage.pathsDescription: Root-relative paths to delete. A directory expands to the deletable files it contains.

uploads.prewarmSummary: Queue preview variants for the given attachments, so opening one does not wait on a resize. Returns once the batch is accepted, not once it is rendered
uploads.prewarmIdsDescription: Attachment ids to warm. Non-images and renditions that already exist are skipped.
uploads.prewarmVariantDescription: Which rendition to have ready (the lightbox uses lg).

errors.deviceRevoked: This device is no longer paired with this instance

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.pluginCoreCannotDisable: Plugin "{pluginId}" is core and cannot be disabled
errors.unknownPreviewVariant: Unknown preview variant "{variant}" — expected one of: {allowed}
errors.transliterationTablesMissing: Transliteration tables folder not found — the paths tried are in the log above
errors.appSecretMissing: APP_SECRET is required and must be at least 32 characters — set it in the environment (see .env.example)
errors.realtimeRoomDenied: Access to this realtime channel is denied
errors.realtimeGuestForbidden: This connection may only listen to its own channel
errors.exchangeCycle: Exchange sections form a dependency cycle
errors.exchangeSectionNamespace: Exchange section "{key}" must be namespaced by its plugin "{pluginId}"
errors.exchangeUnknownDependency: Exchange section "{key}" depends on unknown section "{dep}"
errors.exchangeProviderMissing: Exchange section "{key}" has no registered provider
errors.exchangeDeclarationMissing: Exchange provider "{key}" has no manifest declaration
errors.exchangeRootSectionCount: Exchange root "{rootType}" needs exactly one root section, has {count}
